objective: Aplicar exclusivamente en EDARSAHUB Desarrollo la migracion 003 del modulo Sincronizacion Historica: certificar la primera capability comercial_ventas_cerradas y vincularla solo a capacidades historicas ya existentes de sistemas canonicos soportados. No inferir IDs, no tocar Produccion ni sync_comercial_abiertas_v2.

queries.name: sync_historical_seed_preflight_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS catalog_rows, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS catalog_assertion FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo WHERE Codigo='comercial_ventas_cerradas' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(PermiteResync,0)=1 AND ISNULL(HandlerImplementado,0)=1

queries.name: sync_historical_seed_preflight_system_capabilities
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_system_capabilities, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS capabilities_assertion FROM dbo.Sistema_Capacidades sc JOIN dbo.Sistema_Tipos st ON st.SistemaTipoID=sc.SistemaTipoID WHERE sc.CodigoCapacidad='SYNC_VENTAS_HISTORICAS' AND ISNULL(sc.Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(st.Activo,1)=1 AND st.CodigoSistema IN ('MPRO','SOFTRESTAURANT')

queries.name: sync_historical_seed_preflight_fecha_modificacion
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fecha_modificacion_column, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS fecha_modificacion_assertion FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo') AND name='FechaModificacion'

queries.name: sync_historical_seed_post_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS configured_rows, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS metadata_assertion FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo WHERE Codigo='comercial_ventas_cerradas' AND CategoriaCodigo='VENTAS' AND EntidadCodigo='VENTAS_CERRADAS_KPI' AND CampoFecha='fecha_operacion' AND SoportaResume=1 AND SoportaSafeStop=1 AND VersionContrato='historical-v1' AND ISJSON(ClaveNegocio)=1 AND ISJSON(MetadataJSON)=1

queries.name: sync_historical_seed_post_bindings
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS binding_rows, 1/CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bindings_assertion FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades link JOIN dbo.Sistema_Capacidades cap ON cap.SistemaCapacidadID=link.SistemaCapacidadID JOIN dbo.Sistema_Tipos st ON st.SistemaTipoID=cap.SistemaTipoID WHERE link.CodigoSync='comercial_ventas_cerradas' AND ISNULL(link.Activo,1)=1 AND cap.CodigoCapacidad='SYNC_VENTAS_HISTORICAS' AND st.CodigoSistema IN ('MPRO','SOFTRESTAURANT')
